say:1:1720914001:1.text: Whoa... that's big! Is that actually true?
say:1:1720914001:1.source_cn: 哇，这线索可够劲爆的！这是真的假的？！

choice_prompt:2:1720914001.text: Whoa... that's big! Is that actually true?
choice_prompt:2:1720914001.source_cn: 哇，这线索可够劲爆的！这是真的假的？！

say:3:1720914002:1.text: Then why don't we just follow this lead ourselves? Why go through all this trouble?!
say:3:1720914002:1.source_cn: 那我们直接调查这条线索不就是了！还大费周章找神秘记者干什么？

choice_prompt:4:1720914002.text: Then why don't we just follow this lead ourselves? Why go through all this trouble?!
choice_prompt:4:1720914002.source_cn: 那我们直接调查这条线索不就是了！还大费周章找神秘记者干什么？

say:5:1720914003:0.text: Please don't mess with me right now, detective. I've got enough pressure as it is.
say:5:1720914003:0.male: Please don't mess with me right now, detective. I've got enough pressure as it is.
say:5:1720914003:0.female: Please don't mess with me right now, detective. I've got enough pressure as it is.

narration:6:1720914006:0.text: You and Haria slip your notes into the box.
narration:6:1720914006:0.source_cn: 你和赫蒂奇先后把纸条塞进了信箱
narration:6:1720914006:0.male: You and Haria slip your notes into the box.
narration:6:1720914006:0.female: You and Haria slip your notes into the box.

narration:7:1720914007:0.text: A moment later, you feel the note in the mailbox disappear. Teleportation magic has taken it elsewhere.
narration:7:1720914007:0.source_cn: 随即，你感觉到，信箱中的纸条被传送魔法传送到了别处
narration:7:1720914007:0.male: A moment later, you feel the note in the mailbox disappear. Teleportation magic has taken it elsewhere.
narration:7:1720914007:0.female: A moment later, you feel the note in the mailbox disappear. Teleportation magic has taken it elsewhere.

say:8:1720914008:0.text: You tell Maska and Haria what you've found, and they're both surprised.
say:8:1720914008:0.source_cn: 你将你的发现告诉了马斯卡和赫蒂奇，两人都十分意外。
say:8:1720914008:0.male: You tell Maska and Haria what you've found, and they're both surprised.
say:8:1720914008:0.female: You tell Maska and Haria what you've found, and they're both surprised.

say:10:1720914009:1.source_cn: 传送魔法……还有这种魔法存在！

say:11:1720914010:1.text: They're using magic? Just for a mailbox? That's not normal. No ordinary paper would go this far. This is something else.
say:11:1720914010:1.source_cn: 普通的同行会这么谨慎吗？还用上了魔法……看来这背后确实...

say:12:1720914011:1.text: Wait, the mailbox! We need to put it back exactly where it was before this gives us away.
say:12:1720914011:1.source_cn: 对了！信箱还在我们手上呢，我们把信箱放回原位吧，可不能...

say:14:1720914004:1.text: See? If juicy stories were that easy to come by, I wouldn't have to work so hard chasing leads.
say:14:1720914004:1.source_cn: 我就说嘛，要是劲爆的消息能来得这么容易，我就不用大费周...

say:15:1720914005:1.text: Right... and you definitely don't look like a Mithril Consortium insider. I think I get what you're doing now.
say:15:1720914005:1.source_cn: ……你看起来可不像秘银商会内部人士，我心里有数了。
say:15:1720914005:1.male: Right... and you definitely don't look like a Mithril Consortium insider. I think I get what you're doing now.
say:15:1720914005:1.female: Right... and you definitely don't look like a Mithril Consortium insider. I think I get what you're doing now.

choice:2:2:3.text: It doesn't need to be real.
choice:2:2:3.male: It doesn't need to be real.
choice:2:2:3.female: It doesn't need to be real.
